description:
The Naval Surface Warfare Center, Philadelphia Division (NSWCPD) is seeking to procure seated switch assemblies. This procurement is being conducted as a Firm Fixed Price (FFP), Total Small Business Set-Aside, issued using Simplified Acquisition Procedures.

NSWCPD intends to procure seated switch assemblies in accordance with NAVSEA drawings. The procurement includes the following items:                       

Base Plate

Plate, Cable Mounting

Lever Arm

Shaft, Lever Arm

Cradle, Plunger

Pivot, Plunger

Bushing, Plunger

Stop, Lever Arm

Bushing, Sleeve, Flanged, Lever Arm

Insert, Locking Plunger

Torsion Spring

Magnet

O-Ring

SCREW, CAP, HEX HEAD, .250-20 UNC-2A X 1.250 LG

SCREW, CAP, SOCKET HEAD, #8-32 UNC-3A X .375 LG

SCREW, CAP, HEX HEAD, .250-20 UNC-2A X .750 LG

SCREW, MACHINE, FLAT HEAD, 100, .250-20 UNC-2A X 1.00LG

Fitting, Lubrication

Due to the subject matter of this requirement, interested parties must adhere to the following request process:

  • Method: Request for Quotation (RFQ) requests must be submitted via email only.

  • Required Documentation: Submit a copy of your DD Form 2345 Joint Certification Program (JCP) Certificate.

  • Subject Line: Please reference solicitation number N6449826Q5143 and Seated Switch Assemblies. 

  • Fulfillment: Once the JCP Certificate is verified, the RFQ and associated drawings will be sent to the point of contact provided.

Please submit all JCP forms and any questions to Karen Morris at karen.l.morris49.civ@us.navy.mil. Phone calls will NOT be accepted.
